verdict.rationale: Undermind documents a written synthesis, inline citations that trace statements back to source papers, and cross-paper question answering. None of the evidence describes showing where sources agree or disagree, or flagging conflicting findings. Synthesis, citation tracing and custom tables are adjacent capabilities, not the consensus-versus-disagreement view this story asks for, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can see where sources agree and disagree instead of a single unqualified answer

citations.quote: produces a ranked list of papers with a written synthesis
Trace any statement by following in-line citations back to the source paper
Generate custom tables to support your research.
